title: Why you keep unhelpful habits, even when you know better
hook: Your brain holds onto bad habits for a surprising reason.

narration.text: Your brain holds onto bad habits for a surprising reason.
It is all about the reward system, and it is incredibly powerful.
When you do something, your brain releases dopamine, a feel-good chemical.
This creates a strong association between the action and the good feeling.
Even if the habit becomes unhelpful, your brain still expects that reward.
This makes breaking the habit surprisingly difficult.
Understanding this can help you develop new, healthier routines.
What unhelpful habit have you noticed your brain clinging to?

description: Ever wonder why you stick with habits you know are not good for you? It is not a lack of willpower, it is how your brain's reward system works. Discover the surprising reason your brain holds onto those unhelpful patterns.
topic: Why you continue a habit even when you know it is unhelpful, explaining the reward system's role.
